title: feat(mcp): list_objects and describe_object return the authored object and field description
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg1NmbJpZhtiWQkTir

Fixes #34721
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP 的 `list_objects` 与 `describe_object` 现在把作者写在对象和字段上的 `description` 一并返回(只在写了时出现),HTTP 与 stdio 两条通道同形。
- 为什么改:问数回退到对象工具时,客户端靠读工具返回来挑对象和字段;作者写的说明(如「金额,不含税」)原先拿不到,只能猜。维护者已定不加 synonyms,本卡即其替代。
- 风险与回滚:只增不减,未写说明的对象/字段输出逐字节不变;按调用者字段权限读取,读不到的字段连同其说明一起不出现。体积:app-crm 上 `describe_object` 每个对象约 +1.1 KB,其中约 1.0 KB 来自平台注入的 8 个系统列的说明。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`(HTTP 通道的 `describeServedObject` 与 `listObjectSummaries`)、`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`(stdio 孪生与 `authoredDescription`)、`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`(两条工具描述)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/mcp-object-descriptions-34721.test.ts`,预期 4 passed:可读字段带说明,被拒字段及其说明都不出现。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `describe_object` adds `description` to the object and to each field, and `list_objects` adds it to each object, when the definition as the caller is served it carries a non-blank string there. Otherwise the key is absent, so an object or field with no description is answered exactly as before. The key is the existing `description` of `ObjectSchema` and `FieldSchema`; no metadata key is added.
- Both transports answer the same shape: the HTTP bridge (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `describeServedObject` and `listObjectSummaries`) and the stdio bridge (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` `describeServedObject`, `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts` `listObjects`). Each package carries one helper, `authoredDescription`, the two named as twins.
- The two tool descriptions name the key. `McpObjectSummary` (exported) gains an optional `description` member.
- Field-level security: the text is read off the object the caller is served (ADR-0106 D5), so a field the caller cannot read is removed whole, its description with it. The ADR-0106 projection keeps `description` as prose on the object and on readable fields (`packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-references.ts`, `description: keep`): the same authored text the `/meta` object door serves the same caller when the request names no locale. With a request locale `/meta` translates object and field labels and descriptions; the MCP object tools do not localize labels or descriptions, and this PR leaves that as it was.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-object-descriptions-34721.test.ts` (HTTP bridge, real `SecurityPlugin` on a real `ObjectQL` over SQLite, bridge built by the real `/mcp` entry): a member denied one field is returned the object description and a readable field's description, and neither the denied field nor its description text; the unrestricted control is returned that field's description; a field with no description or a blank one, and an object with none, carry no `description` key; `list_objects` returns the object description and no key on an object without one.
- `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.object-descriptions-34721.test.ts` (stdio bridge behind the real tools over an in-memory MCP client, security from the shared ADR-0106 double): the same four cases.
- Ablation, once per transport, after committing the fix (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which proves the mutation landed and restores to the HEAD blob): deleting the field line `...authoredDescription(f),` turns 2 of 4 tests red on each transport (the readable-field and control cases); restore read back with `git diff HEAD` empty. Both suites import the source under test by relative path, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- Byte cost, measured on `examples/app-crm` (admin, HTTP MCP, tool text bytes, before on `f02f4f63`, after on this branch): `list_objects` 691 to 1193 (+502, all 7 objects carry a description). `describe_object`: `crm_account` 2738 to 3849, `crm_activity` 3791 to 4935, `crm_contact` 2455 to 3558, `crm_lead` 5351 to 6474, `crm_opportunity` 5310 to 6413, about +1.1 KB each. Of that, about 1.05 KB per object is the descriptions of the 8 platform-injected columns (`organization_id`, `created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by`, `owner_id`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue`), the same text on every object; for example `crm_account` would be 2803 without them. No hand-authored app-crm field carries a description today. Whether to serve descriptions on `system: true` fields is left to the seat; this PR follows the ruling (each field's existing description).
- A readable field's or the object's description is free text the ADR-0106 projection does not scan for denied field names (it treats `description` as prose); the same fields' text is already served to the same caller by the `/meta` object door, so no new exposure.
- The reading is on the card: comment 6945187409.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live reading on app-crm, before and after</summary>

Before (`f02f4f63`): `list_objects` objects keyed `name, label, fieldCount`; `describe_object crm_account` field keys `name, type, label, required, readonly, system`; zero `description` keys in either. The same caller's `GET /api/v1/meta/object/crm_account` serves the object description and descriptions on 9 fields.

After (this branch, rebuilt): `list_objects` 7 of 7 objects with `description`; `describe_object crm_account` object description present, 8 of 12 fields with one, e.g. `{"name":"owner_id","type":"lookup","label":"Owner","description":"Record owner (auto-stamped to the creating user on insert; reassignable). Drives owner-scoped views, reports and notifications.","required":false,"readonly":false,"system":true}`.

</details>

<details><summary>Package tests and typecheck</summary>

Run at `c204778e`. The final head `fbc4d13d` differs only by one module-top import in the new runtime test; at `fbc4d13d` that file and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` were rerun green.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: Test Files 67 passed (67), Tests 1230 passed (1230).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 612 passed (612), Tests 11342 passed, 19 skipped (11361).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (the lock's VERDICT command-exit 0).
- New runtime test file rerun after the last commit: Tests 4 passed (4).

</details>

69 derived, 68 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3, reason: shallow clone, its positive-control commit is unreachable here; CI runs it. `pnpm check:test-source-alias` first exited 1 on the new runtime test (the dispatcher reach loads `@objectstack/metadata` lazily); fixed with a module-top import as the sibling suite does, rerun exit 0. After that last commit, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:tier-file-adoption`, `check:issue-citations` rerun, exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 69 accounted, 68 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (derived from the recorded exit 3).
